title: Maximum overshadowing of a diagonally adjacent lot (Table 3.9a)

exceptions.label: C3.9.2 single storey, wall height not more than 3.5 m

replaces.note: Part B did not limit shadow on diagonally adjacent lots

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Same as Chapter 2. Second column of Table 3.9a (half the adjoining-property figure). Table 3.9a footnote 1 (p44): where the development adjoins a grouped dwelling development, the limit applies to each grouped dwelling site area excluding common property (Figure 3.9d); supply the adjoining percentage per dwelling site (adjoining.south.is_grouped_site flags it; not encoded). Not subject to C3.9.3 or C3.9.4. R25 and below: diagonal limit is new (Part B had none). Coding excludes R100-SL: Chapter 3 Table 2.10a (p26) removes all 3.9 provisions for R100-SL, but its footnote restores them where the development abuts a property not coded R100-SL (not encoded).
text: In climate zones 4, 5, and 6, development is designed that its shadow cast at midday, 21 June (refer Figure 3.9a) onto any other adjoining property and/or diagonally adjacent lot (refer Figure 3.9b) does not exceed the limits set out in Table 3.9a.

verified.note: Table 3.9a diagonal column checked: 12.5 / 17.5 / 25 / no maximum (R80 or higher). Exception source cites p43 (the Chapter 2 page); the Chapter 3 page is 45, left unchanged (pairing signature).
